status: pre-outcome lock for the exact public official 18-take validation split
claim_boundary: The exact official split is used to test reproducibility of the published Kinect CD_UL1 reference and the unchanged source-selected correction. Fifteen exact takes are prospectively untouched for this method; FoamDice_T3, PlushOctopus_T6, and ToiletPaperRoll_T1 are disclosed development-overlap controls. The full 18-take comparison is therefore an exact-split SOTA comparison but not wholly prospective. Jaccard is diagnostic because the public target meshes are not guaranteed volumetric under the published boolean implementation.

target_cohort.selection_basis: the exact shot/take arrays hard-coded in upstream test/evaluate.py at the registered upstream commit
target_cohort.overlap_audit_basis: exact take-ID search over tracked Bayesian-PhysTwin source, config, result, script, test, and documentation artifacts before opening the remaining fifteen archives

method.state_update: robust correlation-aware graph registration at f-1
method.transfer: one material-vertex-identity step from f-1 to f
method.required_action_history: finite T_WT, T_WE, and force values for every frame used by the frozen action-local field
method.missing_required_robot_pose_action: mark update unsupported and return byte-identical released checkpoint

official_reference.paper: PokeFlex: A Real-World Dataset of Deformable Objects for Physics-Based Reconstruction
official_reference.published_split_scope: one hard-coded validation recording per each of eighteen objects

custody.template_mesh: allowed explicit task input selected by the frozen upstream robot-metadata rule
custody.prediction_frames: all contiguous f from 6 through the last robot frame; active-frame filtering occurs only during locked scoring
custody.scored_frames: force-y at f exceeds 3 N, matching the registered official evaluator
custody.retry_policy: no replacement; technical failures and exact fallbacks remain in the registered cohort

evaluation.primary_definition: mean nearest-neighbor L1 distance from deterministically sampled predicted surface points to target surface points in original metric coordinates
evaluation.aggregation: equal scored frames over the exact official 18-take split; object-balanced values are diagnostic
evaluation.jaccard_definition: trimesh boolean intersection volume divided by union volume
evaluation.jaccard_role: non-gating reproducibility diagnostic because the released target meshes are not guaranteed volumetric
evaluation.invalid_jaccard_action: report the failure and valid fraction; never substitute a voxel or repaired-mesh surrogate

baseline_reproduction.purpose: direct comparison is authorized only if the released checkpoint reproduces the published reference within five percent

direct_metric_reference.scope: global equal-frame CD_UL1 over the exact official 18-take split

paired_transfer.bootstrap_unit: physical object among the fifteen exact prospective takes

forbidden: opening a prospective target deformed mesh before all eighteen prediction seals pass the barrier
using frame f Kinect or robot observations to predict frame f
substituting T_WT for missing T_WE or otherwise imputing a required actuator pose
changing the selected arm, scale, support radius, metric, aggregation, or gate after target access
tuning from any of the fifteen prospective take outcomes
representing the three disclosed development-overlap takes as prospective
substituting a repaired-mesh or voxel Jaccard for the registered public-mesh diagnostic
claiming direct SOTA comparability if the released baseline reproduction gate fails
touching any held-v8 artifact or process
